title: The River Beneath the Mountain
logline: Wrecked on a beach walled in by cliffs, Sinbad trusts a strange river, rides a plank raft through the dark under the mountain, wakes among kind farmers, and uses the king's favour to bring back the men who waited.
moral: Courage is choosing the unknown way with care, and a good man does not count himself saved until his friends are.
tone: Adventure with warmth: bright sea, a tense wreck without horror, a dark but richly coloured tunnel played as wonder and endurance, a burst of sunlight, and a generous homecoming. Light comic touches from the crew.

beats.summary: Sinbad boards a trading dhow in Baghdad; a happy crew on a calm sea among islands.
A powerful current seizes the ship and drags it toward tall rocky mountains.
The ship strikes the rocks and breaks apart (impact frame CRASH!).
Everyone reaches a narrow beach ringed by cliffs: no way out.
Sinbad finds a strange river that runs away from the sea into a dark opening under the mountain.
The pebbles on its banks shine like jewels.
His idea: the river may come out in a land where people live.
He builds and loads a small raft; the captain gives him the lantern.
The sailors choose to stay and wait for rescue; the captain asks him to send help.
The current carries the raft into the cave.
The low roof: he ducks flat and grips the ropes through a rapid.
Long hours: wonder, then exhaustion; he lies down and closes his eyes, hoping.
He opens his eyes to sunlight and the faces of farmers at the end of the river.
The king hears his story and honours him.
Sinbad asks for a ship for his friends; the king sends his own.
The men who waited see the sail.
Days later all of them are home in Baghdad.
They had thanked the farmers before leaving; the last pebble goes to his sister.

subtitles.en: The captain tried to change course, but the ship struck rocks and broke apart.|Sinbad and several sailors reached a narrow beach surrounded by mountains,|with no way out.

subtitles.ar: بحث السندباد عن ماء وطعام،|فرأى نهرًا غريبًا يجري بين الأحجار ويدخل في فتحة مظلمة تحت الجبل.|وكانت على ضفتيه حصى لامعة تشبه الجواهر.
subtitles.en: Sinbad searched for food and water|and found a strange river running among the stones into a dark opening beneath the mountain.|Sparkling pebbles resembling gems lined its banks.

subtitles.ar: قال لنفسه: «لعل النهر يصل إلى أرض مأهولة».|صنع من ألواح الحطام طوفًا صغيرًا، وحمل عليه طعامه وحصى لامعة.|وقرر البحارة البقاء قرب الشاطئ انتظارًا للنجدة.
subtitles.en: “Perhaps this river reaches inhabited land,” he thought.|He made a small raft from the wreckage and loaded food and bright pebbles onto it.|The sailors stayed near shore, hoping for rescue.

subtitles.ar: ركب السندباد الطوف، وحمله التيار إلى الكهف.|كان مظلمًا وسقفه منخفضًا،|فانحنى ليمر وتمسك بالحبال.
subtitles.en: Sinbad boarded the raft, and the current carried it into the cave.|It was dark with a low roof,|so he ducked and gripped the ropes.

subtitles.ar: سمع السندباد صوت الماء يرتطم بالجدران، ولم يعرف كم مضى من الوقت.|وبعد ساعات طويلة شعر بالتعب، فاستلقى فوق الألواح وأغمض عينيه، وهو يرجو النجاة.
subtitles.en: Sinbad heard water striking the walls and lost track of time.|After long hours he grew exhausted, lay upon the planks, and closed his eyes, hoping to survive.

subtitles.ar: فتح عينيه فرأى الشمس ورجالًا قرب الطوف.|قالوا إنهم مزارعون وجدوه عند نهاية النهر، وأخذوه إلى قريتهم.
subtitles.en: He opened his eyes to sunlight and men beside the raft.|They were farmers who had found him at the river’s end and taken him to their village.

subtitles.ar: روى حكايته لملك البلاد، فأكرمه.|ثم طلب من الملك أن يرسل سفينة إلى الجبل؛ فعاد بها مع البحارة الذين ظلوا ينتظرون.|وبعد أيام رجعوا جميعًا إلى بغداد، وشكروا المزارعين قبل أن يغادروا جميعًا.
subtitles.en: He told the king his story, and the king honored him.|Sinbad asked him to send a ship to the mountain; it brought back the sailors who had waited there.|Days later, they all returned to Baghdad, thanking the farmers before they all left.

new_assets.name: mountainCove
new_assets.description: The narrow wreck beach ringed by cliffs with the waterfall, the stones field, the river and the cave mouth under the mountain (dimensions in sets). Reusable for any shipwreck shore, hidden cove or cave entrance.
new_assets.implementation: One module with a painted plate (paintPlate as in ALI-01 celPlates: sky patch, cliff strata as three polygon bands with soft gradients, mountain above the mouth 1930 high) and cel pieces on top: ledges and cracks as celShade polygons, boulders as SIND-01 stones, waterfall as a white ribbon with dashes stepping on threes, river as a two tone ribbon along a baked centre path with foam dashes moving on t (function coveRiver(u) returns the point for the floating leaf and the raft), cave mouth from townArchPts with an inner plate and an emissive pair. Sea gap reuses openSea layers clipped to x < 700. Front pass redraws near boulders and reeds over the cast.

new_assets.name: riverTunnel
new_assets.description: The underground river in side cutaway with six chapters, dim and lit plates, stalactite front pass, low roof lip and rapid (dimensions in sets). Reusable for any cave river, mine or underground journey.
new_assets.implementation: Each chapter baked twice (dim, lit) at 1500 x 1230: wall bands as wavy polygons, veins as thin polylines, crystals as celShade prisms, glow worms as seeded dots. Per frame: draw dim chapters at -camX, then ctx.save, clip a circle at the lantern (radius from oilLamp), draw the lit chapters, restore; add lampGlow with lighter composite on the plate only. Water: SIND-01 seaY with mood 'tunnel' (amp 4) and 'rapid' (amp 26); reflections as short warm scribbles under the lantern and coloured ones under gem veins. roofY(x) is one function used by both the drawing and the duck timing. Cast and raft are drawn after the plates at full colour with castFinish rim '#ffd27a' toward the lantern; no multiply or tint over them.

new_assets.name: riverVillage
new_assets.description: River end, fields with canals and a waterwheel, and a mud brick village with a far palace (dimensions in sets). Reusable for any farming village, river landing or oasis.
new_assets.implementation: Painted plate: sky, cumulus, far mountain (skyFlight layers), green hill. Cels: cave arch (same piece as the cove mouth, mirrored), river ribbon and reed pool (Library river tones recoloured, reeds as 3 point blades swaying on twos), canals as thin ribbons, fields as skewed strips with furrow lines, waterwheel = circle, 8 spokes, 8 paddles rotating on t with drops on threes, houses from townWall / townDoor / townWindow with dome arcs, palmTree, washing line as a ribbon with 4 cloths, well as a ring and a pole. Front pass: reeds and the near field edge.

new_assets.name: raft
new_assets.description: The plank raft with build stages, pole, flag, cargo and anchors (dimensions in props), plus the people poses used on it.
new_assets.implementation: Deck parallelogram clipped into six strips (alternating two wood tones with celShade edges), cross bars and lashings appear with build; rope loops as stroked arcs; pole as a rotated rect about its foot (pole field); flag as a 3 segment ribbon. Floats with y = seaY(x) and rot from the slope; dip adds a damped offset (rebound). Passenger drawn inside the raft transform: Library person with kneel, sit 'floor' or lie, hands on the loop anchors through handLW / handRW.

new_assets.name: duck (person folded flat)
new_assets.description: Person kneeling folded forward with the chest on the knees and the head low: total height at most 110 at s 0.95, used under the low roof. Field fold 0..1 on top of kneel 1.
new_assets.implementation: In the story: draw the Library person with kneel 1 inside a rotate about the hips of fold * 1.25 rad toward the facing side, head counter rotated by 0.5 * fold so the face still reads, arms through handLW / handRW. If the rotation reads badly on a still, use lie 1 mirrored (face down is not available) with the head propped. Check on stills at 85.4, 85.8 and 86.4.

new_assets.name: gemPebbles and oilLamp
new_assets.description: The shining pebbles (planned jewels, pebble cut) and the ship lantern with lampGlow (planned oilLamp).
new_assets.implementation: Pebble = 5 point rounded polygon with celShade and a facet triangle; glint = four point star scaled by a seeded pulse on celStep(t, 8). Lantern = rect frame, 4 pane lines, flame from 5 polygon drawings picked by flame and a 3 frame flicker; lampGlow = radial gradient drawn on the plate with lighter composite.

new_assets.name: currentStreaks, dhow wreck states, lid point of view
new_assets.description: Three small additions: the current ribbons in the sea, the two wreck states of the dhow, and the eyelid point of view opening.
new_assets.implementation: currentStreaks: 6 seeded ribbons (width 10 to 4, length 500..900) translated on t at speed k, clipped to the near sea layers. Wreck: the SIND-01 hull polygon split by a jagged line into two paths, each with its own transform; mast as two rects with a break angle; debris on seaY. Lid POV: two filled arcs (upper and lower lid, skin shade colour with a lash line) whose gap is driven by flow(tc, LIDS); behind them the scene plate baked at 3 blur levels cross faded.

owner_questions: Everyone survives the wreck on screen (the script says Sinbad and some sailors reached the beach): the captain and all four sailors shown aboard reach the sand and a counter confirms ALL SAFE; default is to keep this softened reading.

A ship lantern saved from the wreck, given by the captain, lights the tunnel (not in the script) so the dark cave stays readable and coloured as the style direction asks; default is to keep it, with the glowing pebbles as the second light.
The lantern burns down to an ember but never goes out, and a point of daylight appears before he sleeps; default is this hopeful version rather than total darkness.

The line 'they thanked the farmers before they all left' comes after 'returned to Baghdad' in the narration, so the thanks are shown as a story balloon picture while Sinbad tells his family on the Baghdad quay; default is the balloon rather than cutting back to the village.
Added picture ending: Sinbad gives the last shining pebble to his sister and the cat chases its light spot under THE END; default is to keep it.

Added foreshadowing and motives not in the script: the captain asks SEND HELP, SINBAD. at the parting and the sailors scratch a tally of days on the cliff; default is to keep both because they set up the rescue.

Invented English lettering and balloons (20 items with the title and THE END): THE CURRENT, HARD TO PORT!, CRASH!, ALL SAFE, NO WAY OUT, GEMS?!, COME WITH ME!, WAITING FOR RESCUE, SEND HELP, SINBAD., LOW ROOF!, SPLASH... splash..., HOURS PASS..., WE ARE FARMERS., THE RIVER'S END, MY FRIENDS ARE STILL WAITING!, SEND MY SHIP!, A SAIL!, DAYS LATER...; default is to use them as written.

The king honours Sinbad with a cream and gold robe, and the king's ship is the series dhow with gold stripes; the farmers bring Sinbad to the king themselves; default is to keep these staging choices.

Comic and animal additions: the crab under the barrel, the frog, three sleepy bats, the child upside down in the waking view, the donkey ride, the SIND-02 cat on the quay; default is to keep them, all gentle.
implementation_notes: Style cel-anime-80s, owner direction first (Library/styles/cel-anime-80s/look.md): frame with S.background(ctx, W, H, t, THEME.page) and S.box(ctx, 54, 54, 972, 1196, 1, THEME.panel); per frame: painted plate, far layers, cels, front passes, light (glows, rims), lettering, S.finish last.

Copy from Animations/SIND-01/src under the same names: the SINBAD pal constant, captain, sailors, family, dhow and skiff, the openSea kit (seaY, seaClip, splash, shore foam), harbourQuay 'baghdad' (morning and gold plates), campfire, plank, spyglass, waterskin, the swim and cling pose, the inset circle. From Animations/SIND-02/src: the skyFlight mountain layers (recoloured as rockCoast and as the far mountain of riverVillage), the diamondValley wall strata code for the cove cliffs, the cat. If a file is not there yet, build to the description in sets and props and keep the name.

Characters on twos: tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps) for every pose channel (flow(tc, KEYS), idleSway(tc, ...), walk(xf, tc)); blinks, lids, glints, foam, fire and drops on celStep(t, 8). Camera, layer slides, the lamp mask, glows and the CRT pass on t.

No tint over the cast anywhere. The tunnel is dark by its plates only: dim plate at mid values with five gem hues, lit plate inside the lantern mask, cast and raft at full normal colour with castFinish(ctx, x, y, w, h, draw, { rim: '#ffd27a', light: [1, -1] }) toward the lantern (it hangs behind him at the stern, so the rim is on his back and turban). Check a still at 82.6, 99.5 and 105.5: skin, white tunic, tangerine and plum must all read as themselves.
Screen direction: the outward journey always moves screen right (ship, current, river, raft, donkey). Only the rescue ship in S18 travels right to left. Keep it.

Raft passenger: draw Sinbad inside the raft transform. Kneel 1 with hands on loopL / loopR (S11, S12), sit 'floor' (S13), lie 1 with the head toward the stern on the food sack (S14; Library lie puts the head toward minus x, which is the stern because the raft travels right). The duck pose is the new fold field; the low lip clearance comes from roofY(x) so the duck must be complete while roofY(raft x) > 700.

The hours passing (97.0 to 104.0) is not a transition card: one continuous shot with the tunnel at 700 units per second, the lantern flame keyed 0.8, 0.6, 0.45, 0.3, 0.15 and Sinbad's pose stepping every 0.5 s. The single tape transition of the film is DAYS LATER... covering 137.4 to 138.5 with the set swap at 137.95, silent.

White bloom at 107.75 to 108.68 then the lid point of view: the white is the first POV image, so the cut is invisible. The POV faces are Library person heads drawn large (s 2.6) and clipped by the panel; only the child is rotated 180.

Speech balloons: S.label(ctx, text, x, y, p, { balloon: true, to: [x, y] }) in the sky or wall band pointing at the speaker, never over a face: HARD TO PORT! 20.0 (captain); COME WITH ME! 68.9 (Sinbad); SEND HELP, SINBAD. 75.0 (captain); WE ARE FARMERS. 114.1 (old farmer); MY FRIENDS ARE STILL WAITING! 128.9 (Sinbad); SEND MY SHIP! 130.6 (king); A SAIL! 134.8 (rose). Tags as plain S.label boxes, with S.arrow where the storyboard says. Title: S.title with the Arabic title_ar from story/script.json in Lalezar under it, 0.3 to 2.8.
Counters: S.counter 1 to 6 for the head count (29.4 to 30.3) and for the six planks (61.6 to 62.6).

Sound (8 effects, master 0.6, each under 0.5 s, all in listed pauses or after the last word): riser 18.4, thud 36.55, chime 54.7, blip 75.35, whoosh 89.0, riser 108.0, blip 122.55, chime 147.0. Nothing under CRASH! (it falls on a word); the transition is silent. The tape bed as the style provides.

Moving holds everywhere (Guide section 15): idleSway on tip and head, breathe on sq, turban tail, sash end, flag and cape as ribbons with lagged, groups with stagger(i) and per member seeds, groundShadow under every hop and landing ({ flat: true } on the deck and the raft). Water, flame, waterfall, waterwheel, reeds and washing lines never stop.

warnings: The tunnel (S12 to S14, 27 s) is the main risk: it must be dark in mood but coloured and readable. Build riverTunnel and the lantern mask first and review stills before any acting.
The duck pose is new and happens fast (85.0 to 86.9); check every second frame.
The lid point of view is the only first person shot in the series; if it reads badly, fall back to a close shot of his face with the lids opening and the faces reflected in his eyes.
Six people on the beach plus raft building in S9 and S10: keep the helpers' actions simple and staggered so the main action stays readable.
The story balloon in S20 carries a narrated event at half scale (figures about 115 px on screen); keep it uncluttered: five figures, a donkey, the ship.
Seven short pauses only; effects are 8 and brief. No effect on the impact frame.
Three new sets plus the raft make four major new assets; all four are reusable, and the cove and tunnel reuse SIND-01 and SIND-02 code.
